# botyard_credential (Data Source)

Looks up one organization-level credential by slug (non-secret metadata only), exposing its `credential_id` for use with `botyard_bot_credential_assignment`. Use it instead of a hard-coded UUID, which differs per organization.

The vendor is exposed as `credential_provider` because `provider` is a reserved attribute name at a data source's root. To list every credential, use `botyard_credentials`.

See [Provider credentials](https://docs.botyard.io/docs/provider-credentials) in the Botyard docs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a credential by slug instead of hard-coding its UUID, which differs
# per organization.
#
# Every organization has the system-created `user-claude-subscription`
# credential. Listing it first in a bot's `llm` scope runs each person's turns
# on their own Claude subscription. It needs a Claude model, and must be at
# ordinal 0. A second `llm` credential below it is the bot's fallback for people
# without a connected Claude. Fallback routing is not live yet: until it is,
# those people get no answer from the bot.
data "botyard_credential" "user_claude" {
  slug = "user-claude-subscription"
}

variable "fallback_llm_credential_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The bot's own LLM credential (managed credits or an API key) used when a person has no connected Claude."
}

resource "botyard_bot_credential_assignment" "per_user_claude" {
  bot_slug = botyard_bot.example.slug

  credentials = [
    {
      credential_id = data.botyard_credential.user_claude.credential_id
      scope         = "llm"
      ordinal       = 0
      default_model = "claude-opus-4-8"
    },
    {
      credential_id = var.fallback_llm_credential_id
      scope         = "llm"
      ordinal       = 1
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug of the credential to look up. Slugs are unique within an organization. Every organization has the system-created `user-claude-subscription` credential, which puts a bot on each person's own Claude subscription when it is first in the bot's `llm` list.

### Read-Only

- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method — `api_key`, `oauth`, or `none`.
- `available_to_all_bots` (Boolean) Whether the credential is available to every bot in the organization.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `credential_id` (String) Unique credential identifier (UUID). Use this as `credential_id` in `botyard_bot_credential_assignment`.
- `credential_provider` (String) Provider vendor (e.g. `openai`, `anthropic`, `brave`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the credential is enabled.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default credential for its scope.
- `key_prefix` (String) First few characters of the API key plus `...`, for identification only (never the full secret). May be null.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label.
- `managed` (Boolean) True when Botyard provisions and funds this credential (managed credits) rather than BYOK.
- `org_id` (String) Owning organization ID.
- `scope` (String) What the credential is used for — `llm`, `web_search`, `image_gen`, or `integration`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).
